name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
  "max_tokens": 400,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule:
Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says 'remote.'

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true:
- The job says worldwide remote.
- The job says work from anywhere.
- The job says global remote.
- The job says APAC remote.
- The job allows international contractors.
- The job accepts people based anywhere.
- The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return ONLY valid JSON with no other text:
{
  "taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "reason": "short reason",
  "location_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"
}

Job post title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Location text: {{ $json.location_text }}

Job description (first 1500 chars):
{{ $json.description.substring(0, 1500) }}"
    }
  ]
}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 600,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Background:
- Bilingual English and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background
- Data science bootcamp experience
- Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics

The job Jerry is applying for:
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Description (first 800 chars): {{ $json.description.substring(0, 800) }}

Make the letter specific to this job.
Mention how Jerry can help the company:
- reduce manual analysis time
- improve reporting speed
- connect marketing and data
- build AI-assisted workflows
- turn messy data into business action

Keep it under 220 words.
Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.
Do NOT include a subject line. Start directly with the body."
    }
  ]
}
